# Port of lib/pubid/un/parser.rb. `token` matches [A-Z0-9.] runs.
#
# Edition-2 typed bindings: `token` repeats (one per slash-separated
# segment) and the builder walks every occurrence as a path element, so
# the repeats collect under token[].token — a scalar binding would keep
# only the first segment. The separator stays a raw "/" literal: a
# parenthesized slash ref materializes a {slash:} node whose presence
# the token-walking builder would read as an empty token.

grammar PubidUn version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  token_char = %x41-5A / %x30-39 / %x2E
  token = ( 1*(%x41-5A / %x30-39 / %x2E) ) as token
  identifier = ["UN "] token 1*( "/" token )
  slash = "/"

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    token -> token[].token (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "UN/CEFACT/TBG14"
    accept "CEFACT/TBG14"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
